preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 3*10**5 for s in s_list)
preconditions.description: Each string s has a length between 1 and 300,000.
Each string s consists of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines is equal to the number of test cases plus one.

postconditions.expression: all(output_lines[i] in ['YES', 'NO'] for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: Each of the first t lines of output is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_lines[i+1]) == len(s_list[i]) + 1 for i in range(t) if output_lines[i] == 'YES')
postconditions.description: If the i-th line is 'YES', the (i+1)-th line is a string of length |s| + 1.

postconditions.expression: all(output_lines[i+1].islower() for i in range(t) if output_lines[i] == 'YES')
postconditions.description: If the i-th line is 'YES', the (i+1)-th line consists of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: all(not is_palindrome(output_lines[i+1]) for i in range(t) if output_lines[i] == 'YES')
postconditions.description: If the i-th line is 'YES', the (i+1)-th line is not a palindrome.

postconditions.expression: all(output_lines[i+1] == s_list[i] for i in range(t) if output_lines[i] == 'NO')
postconditions.description: If the i-th line is 'NO', the (i+1)-th line is the original string s.
